name: macos-control
description: Controls native macOS applications via the Native Dashboard bridge.

open_app.description: Opens a macOS application by name (e.g. Notes, Finder, Music).

app_name.description: The name of the application to open.

run_applescript.description: Runs a custom AppleScript command via the Native Dashboard.

get_clipboard.description: Retrieves the current text content of the macOS clipboard.
